text:
Ashley (PM): quick sync — we need to lock scope for the next Optimize toolkit slice. goal: actionable recommendations for batching, caching, and quantization plus eval-triggered alerts. decision needed by end of day wed. proposing 3 parallel slices:
Ashley (PM): 1) Advisor-Lite: heuristic recs (batch size, cache TTLs) + docs/examples — target pilot only.
Ashley (PM): 2) Advisor-Full: per-tenant recommendations, quant profiles, rollout guidance, cost/latency tradeoff UI.
Ashley (PM): 3) Eval Alerts: eval harness -> signals -> alerting -> ops runbook.
Jing (Eng-ML): tiny note: quant recs need model-specific safety checks. some models show coherence regressions at Q4-PTX. we should gate full quant recommendations behind A/B evals.
Ben (Eng): rough capacity/effort: advisor-lite = 3 sprints (data + simple rule engine + SDK), advisor-full = 8-10 sprints (profiling, per-tenant scoring, UI), eval-alerts = 4 sprints (harness + signals + pager integration). can shorten if we scope down features.
Sofia (Solutions): bringing customer voice: AcmeHealth asked for deterministic cost guidance and a way to opt out of quant recs. acceptance criteria from them: p95 gen latency <= 300ms on hosted plan, and quant recs must include rollback playbook.
Leo (Eng-SRE): ops constraints: must support canary traffic (1% initial), automatic fallback to baseline model when error rate > 2% or latency spike > 3x. also need telemetry tags per recommendation so we can query impact.
Ashley (PM): proposed launch criteria (alpha to pilot customers):
- alpha SDK + quickstart + 2 pilot customers onboarded
- basic cost/latency estimation for each rec (est method documented)
- eval-alert integration with alerting stack + runbook
- canary rollout path + automated fallback
Jing (Eng-ML): for eval-triggered alerts, suggestion for a simple rule engine: run evals on a rolling window, compute delta vs baseline, trigger WHEN delta_quality_drop > 2% AND p95_latency_increase > 20% for 3 consecutive windows. sample config:
```yaml
alert_name: model_regression
window: 60m
quality_metric: accuracy@50
quality_delta_threshold: 0.02
latency_delta_threshold: 0.20
consecutive_windows: 3
notify: [pagerduty, slack]
```
Ben (Eng): question: do we ship quantization recommendations in advisor-lite? my vote is NO — too risky. ship batch/cache recs and eval-alert plumbing first, then add quant as opt-in in advisor-full.
Sofia (Solutions): +1 to opt-in quant. pilot customers prefer conservative defaults. offer a "safety review" checkbox in onboarding.
Ashley (PM): new proposed scope to vote on:
- MVP (ship by pilot): batching heuristics, cache TTL suggestions, SDK examples, eval-alert plumbing, docs, runbook.
- Post-MVP: per-tenant advisor, quant recs (opt-in), UI to visualize cost/latency tradeoffs.
Leo (Eng-SRE): can we add SLOs to launch criteria? e.g. 99.9% availability for the advisor API, and telemetry retention for 90 days for debugging.
Ashley (PM): yes — add SLO and retention to criteria.
Jing (Eng-ML): on the data side we'll need: token distribution samples, request sequencing (typical lengths), model variant matrix. engineering ask: product to finalize sample list by monday.
Sofia (Solutions): pilot customers: AcmeHealth (HIPAA), Nimbly (SaaS chat), BetaCorp (embedded). Acme will need private deploy capability for quant opt-in.
Ben (Eng): owners:
- Advisor-Lite engineering: @Ben
- Eval-alerts: @Jing + @Leo (ops)
- Docs / SDK: @Sofia + @Ashley
- Quant roadmap: start design but gated: @Jing
Ashley (PM): next steps:
1) I'll write RFC draft by EOD today and link it here.
2) Engineering to confirm estimates Tues.
3) Schedule stakeholder workshop Wed 10am to finalize scope.
4) Product to collect sample telemetry list by monday.
deploy-bot: RFC draft created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/rfc-optimize-mosaic-draft (editable) :sparkles:
Ben (Eng): acked. i'll push a narrower proposal if we need faster ship.
Sofia (Solutions): i'll prep customer ask matrix before the workshop.
Jing (Eng-ML): will sketch the eval plumbing and proto alert runner this week.
Leo (Eng-SRE): i'll draft canary + fallback runbook and SLO text.
Ashley (PM): thanks all — please react with :+1: if you agree to the MVP split (batch/cache + eval-alerts) and we lock quant as post-MVP opt-in.
Ben (Eng): :+1:
Jing (Eng-ML): :+1:
Sofia (Solutions): :+1:
Leo (Eng-SRE): :+1:
Ashley (PM): locking decision then. RFC link above — comment inline.
